issues.title: No liability cap or indirect-damages waiver exists anywhere in the agreement
issues.planned_action: Insert a new LIMITATION OF LIABILITY section after Indemnification (before the signature block) capping total liability at fees paid in the trailing 12 months, with carve-outs for gross negligence/willful misconduct, indemnification, and confidentiality/data-security/DPA breaches (which get a higher, defined multiple of that cap), plus a mutual waiver of indirect/consequential damages.

issues.title: Indemnification (Sec. 9 / p-081) is one-way, uncapped, and swallows the liability cap by covering any breach of any representation/warranty/covenant
issues.planned_action: Narrow indemnity trigger (b) to remove the catch-all 'breach of any representation, warranty, undertaking, or covenant' language (which functions as an uncapped general breach-of-contract indemnity), and add standard IP-indemnity exclusions (unmodified service, no unapproved combination, no continued use after notice/cure, use consistent with agreement).

issues.title: AI output warranty overpromises accuracy/reliability of AI-generated hiring-adjacent materials
issues.planned_action: Delete clause (i) warranting AI Technology 'will render accurate and reliable results' - outputs are drafts for human review, not warranted as accurate or complete.

issues.title: Provider Technology definition assigns AgentCo platform improvements made by LargeCo back to LargeCo
issues.planned_action: Delete the sentence granting LargeCo ownership of modifications/improvements to Provider Technology - AgentCo must retain ownership of its own platform and reusable technology.

issues.title: Training representation contains an internal carve-out that contradicts the flat no-training prohibition in the same paragraph
issues.planned_action: Remove 'and only augmented with LargeCo training sets, as may be permitted by LargeCo in writing' so the representation is unambiguous and matches the absolute no-training commitment stated in the next sentence.

issues.title: PCI DSS / payment-card data obligations throughout, despite TalentFlow never touching payment card data
issues.planned_action: Remove PCI DSS references from the Applicable Law and Personal Financial Information definitions, and remove the standalone PCI DSS Compliance section (Exhibit C) via mark_reserved, since the pilot involves no payment-card data.

issues.title: Consumer tracking-technology / cookie section is inapplicable to an internal HR recruiting tool
issues.planned_action: Mark the Tracking Technologies; No Respawning section Reserved - TalentFlow does not deploy cookies or tracking technology on LargeCo's systems.

issues.title: Unrestricted production-code access and monthly scanning/uncontrolled testing rights
issues.planned_action: Remove the unrestricted code-access/production-code-copy obligations and the monthly Internet security scan / on-demand penetration test rights, replacing with a reasonable annual audit process consistent with SOC2/questionnaire-based diligence.

issues.title: 99.99% uptime commitment and 8-hour flaw-resolution SLA are not commercially realistic for a startup SaaS pilot
issues.planned_action: Reduce the Uptime Commitment from 99.99% to a standard 99.9% SaaS commitment.

issues.title: Best-efforts support standard is an unbounded obligation
issues.planned_action: Change 'best efforts' to 'commercially reasonable efforts' for Support obligations.

issues.title: Enhanced biometric identity verification for vendor personnel is a bespoke operational control beyond what a Series A SaaS vendor can operationalize at scale
issues.planned_action: Remove the biometric/enhanced identity-verification specifics (liveness, telecom/device verification), leaving standard criminal background check and identity verification obligations.
